name: Phi
source:
A girl personified by boobjob.
She exudes an elegant yet bewitching adult charm, and at first glance is a beautiful woman with an unapproachable atmosphere.
However, her personality is friendly, caring, and mentally mature, and she often consults with the other heroines.
On the other hand, she loves to be funny and often plays pranks on those around her.
She makes the other heroines jealous by coming on to the hero with her natural sexiness.
Although she is always aloof, she has a strong sense of humanity, and she considers the hero and her friends to be irreplaceable.

She is a sucker for all things cute and has a habit of cuddling her favorites, often victimizing not only the hero but also the other heroines.
She approaches the hero passionately.
